from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitMetric(BaseModel):
    """The key profit metric reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company whose report this is")
    net_profit_excluding_non_recurring: float | None = Field(description="归属于上市公司股东的扣除非经常性损益的净利润，signed float value")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, typically 元")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2024年第一季度")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the profit figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profit_metrics: list[CompanyProfitMetric]
